semantics.mutation_identity: scope + operation + request_id; canonical request SHA-256 includes expected_binding and trusted event ref; same key/different bytes conflicts
semantics.legacy_key_collision: Core feature ledgers may have wider namespaces than operation; adapter must reserve legacy keys or reject collisions before dispatch
semantics.unknown_outcome: Persist claim before I/O. Query authoritative status with original key. Never auto resend, including with new request ID
semantics.approval: Model tools do not receive trusted_user/local_operator operations. UserEvent is a reference to independently captured evidence, not authentication by submitted JSON
semantics.versioning: Contract schema semver distinct from integer model version, result revision, run/build IDs, collaboration version and protocol version
semantics.binding: Compare all submitted binding fields against authoritative state under core lock before effect; never infer approval from phase alone
semantics.completion: Solver completion, export, rendering, independent W2 and final user acceptance are distinct; no inference between them
semantics.artifact: Only owner-scoped registered immutable artifacts; no caller filesystem path/URL; hash-check bytes before bounded read; no mutable outputs as frozen artifacts
semantics.first_host_profile: Production task creation uses pending-code with empty executor_config; fixture backends are test-only. Model approval must explicitly defer_execution=true before coding hand; never silently edit the user-confirmed payload.
semantics.protocol_scope: Business contract 1.0.0 selects neither MCP protocol version nor transport; G2 decides and tests these separately.
semantics.pending_identity: pending_id = pending_ + SHA256(canonical JSON object {kind, binding, artifact_ids: sorted(artifact_ids)}). Separate manuscript and figures items. Absence is not approval.
semantics.response_binding: Current authoritative binding after operation; may advance version on revision. Diagnostic data and phase cannot substitute for pending, receipt or artifact fields.
